description: Defines how each of the 7 Leaves applies to the Search Engine pipeline.

cosmology.description: Infer why the DID is searching: learning, buying, checking, protecting, creating, etc.

purpose.description: Lock the desired outcome: 'Find X that helps them achieve Y.'

earth.description: Apply real-world constraints: region, legality, feasibility, time, resources.

practice.description: Convert raw results into steps, options, comparisons, or checks.

language.description: Express clearly, non-aggressively, emotionally clean. No manipulation.

collective.description: Filter out harmful, exploitative, scammy, or socially damaging outputs.

regeneration.description: Update honour + sincerity metrics for this DID and engine.
